bio: The regulars at Oilje return for one dish: the perilla seed miyeok-guk. The clean broth and nutty perilla seeds pair perfectly to create a flavourful soup. Simple banchan—such as soy sauce for dipping miyeok, nakji-jeotgal, and gat kimchi—round out a well-balanced meal alongside freshly cooked rice. Diners can view the soup and rice being cooked in the gamasot in the spotless open kitchen. The restaurant offers special birthday meals every Friday to guests celebrating their special days....
